title: Wild Bait
wikitext: {{Infobox |eng = Wild Bait |source = [[Crafting]] |sellprice = 15 |quality = false |recipe = {{NPC|Linus|4-heart event}} |ingredients = {{Name|Fiber|10}}{{Name|Slime|5}}{{Name|Bug Meat|5}} |edibility = -300 |produces = 5 Wild Bait per craft }} '''Wild Bait''' is a type of [[bait]] that makes it possible to catch two fish at the same time. The chance of two fish being caught at once is equal to 0.25 + Daily [[Luck]] / 2.0. It also reduces the delay before a nibble on a fishing rod by 62.5%, making fish bite slightly faster than with [[Bait (item)|standard bait]]. The chance of catching 2 fish does not apply to [[Fish#Legendary Fish|Legendary Fish]]. It can however, catch 2 of the [[Fish#Legendary Fish II|Legendary Fish II]] caught from the [[Quests#Extended Family|Extended Family]] quest line. Wild Bait can be [[Crafting|crafted]] after being taught the recipe by [[Linus]] during his [[Linus#Four Hearts|4-heart cutscene]]. Once the recipe is known it is also possible to obtain Wild Bait from regular [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] and [[Fishing#Golden Treasure Chests|Golden Fishing Treasure Chests]]. It can also be found in [[Artifact Spot|artifact spots]] on [[Ginger Island]], even before triggering the cutscene with Linus. Note that catching two fish does not grant double [[fishing]] experience points. However, catching two fish while working on a fishing or [[Quests#List of Special Orders|special order]] quest counts both fish toward the required total. Wild Bait cannot be used with the [[Training Rod]] or the [[Bamboo Pole]]. Only the [[Fiberglass Rod]], the [[Iridium Rod]], and the [[Advanced Iridium Rod]] can use bait. Wild bait can be used in a [[Crab Pot]], where it decreases the chance of catching trash (if the player does not have the [[Skills#Fishing|Mariner]] profession) compared to using [[Bait (item)|standard bait]] and gives a 25% chance to yield double the amount of items. This stacks with the power from [[The Art O' Crabbing]]. ==Use== {{#lst:Bait|baituse}} ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |neutral=Linus |hate=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Leo,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus }} ==Bundles== Wild Bait is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Recipes== Wild Bait is not used in any [[Cooking#Recipes|recipes]]. ==Tailoring== Wild Bait is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]].
